items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: Yeah, Anstead. Peggy Anstead. Yeah, an opera. I used to play for Merritt sometimes over

ctx.x: That's all. I never had no big bands in there. There was only five men over the tracks in the real joint halls over there in the Tangle Palace. I worked there with Henry and Merritt Brunus. And I don't know who played piano. But I'll never forget that place over there. Remember Peg Leg?

Yeah, Anstead. Peggy Anstead. Yeah, an opera. I used to play for Merritt sometimes over there. They had a Jewish fellow piano player. Oh, really? I can't even place what was on. And they had Henry. Henry was playing trombone. I was playing cornet. And I think it was Eagle Beak Lamb that was on drums.
